notes: Passive, unpowered 1RU analog audio patchbay from ADC's Pro Patch (ProPatch Lite) longframe series — a 2x24 array of WECO-standard longframe (full-size 1/4"/6.35mm) audio patch jacks, wired point-to-point per circuit (top jack N normalled/paired with bottom jack N+24). No connector in the required enum is an exact match for WECO "longframe" jacks; trs-6.35 (standard 1/4" phone/TRS) is the closest physical/electrical equivalent and is used for all 48 jacks. Jacks are pass-through patch points, so direction is modeled as bidirectional for every jack (this is not a powered/electronic device — front jacks don't have inherent "source vs. sink" behavior the way an amplifier port does). Model-code decoding is inferred: primary source found (ADC's own "Pro Patch Professional Audio Patchbays" datasheet, 3/06 edition, www.adc.com) documents the ordering scheme for the modern MK-series (e.g. PPA1-14MKIVNS) where A=longframe regular-spaced jacks, 1=1RU height, NS=normals strapped (fully normalled). The exact SKU "PPA1-24-NS-CG" does not appear in that datasheet verbatim — it matches an older/simplified pre-MK naming convention (no explicit chassis-depth or MK-generation code), confirmed to exist and described as "1RU Longframe 2x24 audio Panel" by two independent retailer listings (BS Broadcast, Broadcast Store). "CG" is not documented in the datasheet I could access; it most likely denotes a common/bussed-ground normalling variant (the datasheet's newer catalog uses "BG" for bussed grounds, and BS Broadcast's description of related normalling options references "common ground") — this is an inference, not confirmed. Rear termination type (solder tail vs. QCP punchdown vs. connectorized backplane) could not be confirmed for this specific SKU/vintage; the datasheet shows both wire-wrap/solder-tail and QCP II/IV punchdown as period options, but since no rear-termination code (E/A/3E/E8/E56/M/E90/E120) appears in the model number, this is very likely a solderless punchdown or wire-wrap rear (not separately modeled as a connector here since it's an internal termination, not a device "port"). No AC/DC power input exists — this is a fully passive panel. Secondary source for the exact SKU: https://www.bsbroadcast.com/adc-ppa1-24-ns-cg-1-ru-longframe-2x24-audio-panel.html
